expanded_body:
Originally posted October 7, 2026.

We're back at it tonight!

It's Wednesday night $5/$10 No-Limit Hold'em on the feature stream at Champions Social Club in Dallas, and I'm back in the commentary booth alongside Hayden Fortini — so you already know it's going to be a good one.

And if you haven't played at Champions Social Club yet, then you probably haven't tried the kitchen's glazed lamb lollipops (featured in the promo reel on Facebook at https://www.facebook.com/reel/1085303500976218/). Trust me, you're missing out.

Come pull up a seat at the tables, or tune in to the broadcast and jump in the live chat. Let's go!

— Sham
author: Shomari Williams
